# Display snippets for docs/tcp.md

--8<-- [start:connect_example]
connect("example.com", 80, SOCKET)
--8<-- [end:connect_example]

--8<-- [start:server_example]
listen("0.0.0.0", 8080, SERVER),
accept(SERVER, CLIENT),
receive(CLIENT, DATA),
send(CLIENT, DATA),    # echo back
close(CLIENT),
close(SERVER)
--8<-- [end:server_example]

--8<-- [start:data_transfer_examples]
send(SOCKET, "Hello, server!")
receive(SOCKET, RESPONSE)

# Custom buffer size
receive(SOCKET, 65536, LARGE_DATA)
--8<-- [end:data_transfer_examples]

--8<-- [start:socket_management_example]
set_timeout(SOCKET, 5.0),     # 5-second timeout
receive(SOCKET, DATA)         # fails if no data within 5 seconds
--8<-- [end:socket_management_example]

--8<-- [start:tcp_client_example]
-import_from(py.tcp, [connect, send, receive, close])

tcp_request(HOST, PORT, REQUEST, RESPONSE) <- (
    connect(HOST, PORT, S),
    send(S, REQUEST),
    receive(S, RESPONSE),
    close(S)
)
--8<-- [end:tcp_client_example]

--8<-- [start:echo_server_example]
-import_from(py.tcp, [listen, accept, send, receive, close])

echo_server(PORT) <- (
    listen("0.0.0.0", PORT, SERVER),
    accept(SERVER, CLIENT),
    receive(CLIENT, DATA),
    send(CLIENT, DATA),
    close(CLIENT),
    close(SERVER)
)
--8<-- [end:echo_server_example]
